Then you get to the production side who also directly benefit. More consumption means more production and helps these guys stay in business and maintain revenue.

Fundamentally subsidies tend to cycle through the whole economy before working their way up to the top. Sometimes it ends there and just ends up in a vault with billions of other dollars, but at least to some small degree supply side economics has some merit and this money ends up getting reinvested and goes right back down to the lower middle as another little idea becomes a reality and the cycle continues.

I'm not so keen on the subsidies that start at the top since they tend to cycle through the economy less before ended up in a digital vault.
